notes.title: Leaderboard Patch (1.4.3)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I just made a patch to Torecower meant to fix our weekly leaderboard that wasn't filling new people in.

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1092423492990931067/1254879518816997451/image.png?ex=667b191f&is=6679c79f&hm=f41c09f5676a3d1ed14f26dd18f67050220437e905f517c7ad43c4250f18c389&=&format=webp&quality=lossless[/img]

I'd like to also thank you everyone who played the game so far. In special: "Yo", "Toeazy" and "theeviru", who were the all-time top three (removing the obsviously cheaters 😅). You're real ones!

That said, there's another thing bothering me, which is: the leaderboard is now weekly, but after a week if your next scores are lesser than your previously stored in the game's database, you wouldn't appear in the current highscore. This still needs an actual fix, but in the meantime, I've just reset everyone's scores.*

*Don't worry, though. I have a backup of all of it, if you're curious just ask on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/CbXrxCmUv3]Discord Server.[/url]

Thanks for reading
- Cuca

notes.title: Quality of Life fixes + Made In Brazil Sale
notes.content:
[h1]Hello gamers![/h1]
Long time no see, huh? We have some updates!

[h2]Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Shop] You no longer will lose your money if you're with a selected tower when the wave ends;
[*] [Gamepad] Fixed bug where you could select a talent in menu while they were closed
[*] [Gamepad] Fixed the leaderboard scroll using D-PAD up/down
[/list]

[h2]Made in Brazil Sale[/h2]
As in the title, Torecower will be part of the Made In Brazil Sale, during feb. 14-19, with a 35% discount, so that's the opportunity if you don't have the game yet!

[h3]Siege 'n Sow & Community[/h3]
If you're not aware, I (Cuca) am currently working on a new game, Siege 'n Sow: a minimalist real-time strategy game, you can already [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2773700/Siege_n_Sow/]wishlist it here[/url].

And we're also moving our community to [url=https://discord.com/invite/CbXrxCmUv3]this new Discord server[/url], so it's the best place to get information about the new games & report bugs on the already existing ones.

See you soon!

notes.title: Welcome, Steam Deck and controllers! Full gamepad support and more
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

Before showing the new stuff, we wanted to thank all the new players which came during latest Steam Spring Sale, we hope you can enjoy it as much as us. The game reached 1000 copies sold during this sale and we're so happy for this!

[b]Leave a review with your feedback or reach out to us, we really want to make awesome games and your feedback is the best input we can have :)[/b]

We are excited to announce the latest update to our game, which includes several fixes, improvements, and additions. Here are the patch notes:
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed typos on talents and skills texts
[*] Fixed a bug in the local save file for game settings
[*] Fixed a crash on macOS when attempting to change resolution
[*] Fixed 10,000 enemies achievement
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made many small quality of life improvements
[*] Added full gamepad support
[/list]
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Try Hard:[/b] This new talent enables a new achievement and difficulty game mode for those who seek a challenge.
[/list]
[h3]Join our Discord community[/h3]
As always, we appreciate your continued support and hope that you enjoy these changes. Join our Discord community to share your thoughts and feedback with us:
[list]
[*][url=https://discord.com/invite/ZyjZdBYjge]https://discord.com/invite/ZyjZdBYjge[/url]
[/list]

We still want to do some improvements such as adding vibration to the game, but we do not have a gamepad with compatibility in the engine we use, so it's pretty hard to test it properly.

Thank you for playing our game, and we hope you enjoy the latest update!

notes.title: Torecower 1.3.0 is out! Major skill tree additions and QOL improvements
notes.content:
Hey! We're so happy with the reception the game is having so far, we're working hard on it to bring the best experience possible to you all!

If you experience any bug, please do report it in our Discord Server:
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZyjZdBYjge]https://discord.com/invite/ZyjZdBYjge
[/url][/list]

[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Leaderboard now shows up to 10 best scores from last 7 days
[*] Steam Cloud across platforms and devices (macOS, Windows and Linux/SteamOS)
[/list]

[h2]Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bank towers doesn't produce coins until game starts (reported exploit)

[list]

[list]
[*] [b]Lucky Strike: [/b]Increases critical chance by 10%

[h3]Arcane[/h3]

[/list]

That's all for this update! Hope you like it!

notes.title: Torecower 1.2.6 is out!
notes.content:
We had lots of bumps from 1.2.0 to 1.2.5 to make quick hot-fixes since the major update, now, we did a few small but needed updates and fixes!

[h3]Fix | Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Achievements fixed
[*] Healer tree path is blocked until you actually unlocks its towers
[*] You recover part of the price spent on towers when they get destroyed
[/list]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Arcane Burning:[/b] (talent) arcane towers projectile burns enemies (damage over time)
[*] [b]Tutorial:[/b] the game now requires to your first towers to be placed next your core in order to avoid first-run-deaths due to placing it far from it
[*] [b]Enemies:[/b] new frost immune enemy
[/list]

There's also a lot of minor adjustments to improve QOL. Thank you all for playing our game!

[h3]Discord[/h3]
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZyjZdBYjge]https://discord.com/invite/ZyjZdBYjge[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Torecower 1.2.0 is out! Talents, NG+ and more!
QoL Updates and Bug Fixes (1.0.5)
notes.content:
Hey there! Thanks for playing Torecower, we really appreciate all the feedback. Feel free to give your thoughts on our [url=https://discord.gg/uM2DfE9WBD]Discord[/url].

We're happy and working hard on the game, planning a lot of updates and DEFINITELY reworking some code. Here is a list of some changes you may expect in this update.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Frost Upgrades[/b] - Frost didn't have any upgrades and felt so weak, so we buffed it and made 9 new upgrades!
[*] [b]Better UI[/b] - Some words have been replaced by icons, eg: "damage" has been replaced by a little sword icon.
[*] [b]Money, money and money![/b] - The coin drop chance has been increased, which makes the early game easier (45% -> 50%).
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Achievements[/b] - We've received a lot of reports about achievements not being triggered, we're really sorry about that. Fixed!
[*] [b]Shop[/b] - Some screen sizes made possible to buy two towers at the same time, which IS NOT intended. Fixed by adding a new overlay.
[/list]

Thanks for reading, have a great day! 😊✨
